resources.string: Select One-way only to decline a round trip, or select a date and time for your return trip.

This app collects location data to enable trip alerts to notify you when your trip is starting, alert you about nearby stops during an ongoing trip, and inform you upon arriving at your destination, even when the app is closed or not in use. This ensures you receive timely updates and have a smoother travel experience. We prioritize your privacy and use this data solely for enhancing your travel with us.

Um die Transportoptionen anzuzeigen, teilen wir ggf. Informationen über Startpunkt, Endpunkt und Abfragezeit mit Transportdienstleistern. Du kannst jeden Modus einzeln deaktivieren, für welchen du die Daten nicht mit den entsprechenden Transportdienstleistern teilen möchtest.
We keep anonymised trip data on servers in Australia, Europe, or the US. We retain this data forever to be able to create long-term trends. For more details see our Privacy Policy.
